user_agent.description: User-Agent header value sent to the stream server

stdout.description: If true, output the stream to stdout instead of a file

verbose.description: If true, enable verbose logging to stderr

quiet.description: If true, suppress normal output messages

split_tracks.description: If true, split the stream into individual tracks based on playlist metadata

output_filename.description: Filename pattern for saved streams. Supports strftime format codes.

stop_limit.description: Stop downloading after N kb/mb/min/songs. Empty string means no limit.

sync.description: If true, turn on syncing (required for some mpeg players)

streams.description: List of stream URLs (icecast, shoutcast, m3u, pls) to download
